body.h: In this pattern all the passes are straight double passes. Ben starts with four clubs, one beat before everyone else. Ben does a sweep feed on two count. He passes to his left, the middle, his right and then the middle again. He also passes to each juggler in turn: Anne, then Clare, then Daniel. Anne, Clare and Daniel pass to Ben on six count as they walk around a figure of eight pattern. They pass to Ben as they walk backwards on the edge of the figure of eight pattern, and also as they walk forwards through the middle of the figure of eight pattern.
This pattern is easier if the feeder calls out each person's name as he passes to them.
Here's the causal diagram for the pattern:
Colour coding: use seven red clubs for the passes and six green clubs for the self throws.
Note: you can do this weave with straight single passes.
